title: The cedar mill, i
logline: Tuesday. Chloe home, in a camel coat that costs more than the Datsun. She wants to see the mill. Nobody's wanted to see the mill since it closed.

panels.composition: Gully's. CHLOE, twenty-eight, in a camel coat, at the counter — the coat the only clean color in the strip. WOOD on the stool. BARNABY sniffing the coat's hem.

balloons.text: I want to see the mill.
Since '94. I know. I want to see it.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a woman in an expensive camel coat at a bait-shop counter, the coat the only clean color, a thin man on a stool and a small dog sniffing her hem
image.notes: One spot color: the camel coat, all week.

panels.composition: The coat's hem, the dog's nose, the shack's floor.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, close-up of a small dog's nose at the hem of a camel coat on a rough shack floor

panels.composition: Wood, to the coat more than to her.

balloons.text: That coat's going to get blackberry on it.
It's a coat that's been to Portland.

panels.composition: The three of them going out the door toward the road east. The coat, the man, the dog. Gully behind the counter watching the door for a beat.
